family: published equity month-end calendar effect plus Treasury-bill carry
entry: last NYSE session of month OPEN, limit-on-open at 1.02 times previous close, integer shares sized from available cash including costs
exit: third session next month CLOSE; predetermined market-on-close sell of held quantity
outside_window: BIL; sell at prior session CLOSE before equity entry; buy at next session OPEN after equity exit; cash overnight between switches
unfilled_limit: remain cash through the scheduled window; no retry or substitute
dividends: unadjusted prices plus ex-date receivable based on prior-close holdings; cash reinvestable 90 calendar days later; this is a conservative modeled delay, not exact pay-date history
splits: reject any observed split or missing/invalid bar; no repair or resampling
calendar: XNYS exchange_calendars4.11.1, archived full schedule; special closures and early closes retained
commission_each_side: max(1USD,0.005USD per share) plus 1.5bps notional for spread/slippage/other fees; double entire cost for stress
controls: 10th-to-13th session equity window with BIL otherwise
100 seeded random four-session monthly windows, fully funded replay
screen: positive net return and CAGR above BIL at both costs; close drawdown <=25%; positive compounded returns in all fixed calendar blocks2009-13/2014-18/2019-23/2024-26; random-window right-tail (1+count>=candidate)/(101) <=0.10 at baseline
source_outcome_exposure: paper reports and unsolicited secondary recent-SPY calendar performance snippet seen before freeze; no blind-source replication claim
data_class: retrospective development, including post-publication history; not untouched future confirmation
